name: Apply Transformations to Diffusion Metrics
summary: Applies an existing ANTs or FSL transform to diffusion metric maps (tensor FA/MD/RD/AD or NODDI NDI/ISOVF/ODI) with ANTs antsApplyTransforms, resampling them onto a T1w or T2w reference.
description: Wraps antsApplyTransforms to move scalar diffusion maps into another space using a precomputed transform (warp, inverse warp and affine). Provide tensor and/or NODDI maps; each present scalar map is resliced. The reference grid is the T1w image if given, otherwise the T2w image; one of them is required. The NODDI direction field is deliberately not transformed because reslicing vector components would not rotate them correctly. It does not estimate a registration.

inputs.description: Precomputed transform: nonlinear warp, inverse warp and affine matrix (ANTs format, or FSL FLIRT/FNIRT when fsl_transform is set).
inputs.requirements: The warp matching the chosen direction must be present unless affine_only is set.

inputs.description: Optional tensor scalar maps (FA, MD, RD, AD) to transform.
Optional NODDI scalar maps (NDI, ISOVF, ODI) to transform.
Optional T1w image used as the reference grid (first choice).
Optional T2w image used as the reference grid if no T1w reference is given.

outputs.description: The diffusion metric map(s), resliced onto the reference grid.

parameters.description: Apply only the affine transformation, skip any warp field
If true, converts affine and warp from FSL to ANTs-compatible format

failure_modes.message: Error: No valid anatomical reference found in config.json
failure_modes.fix: Provide a T1w or T2w reference image.

failure_modes.message: Error: affine_only is false but appropriate warp is missing
failure_modes.cause: The transform lacks the warp (or inverse warp when inverse is set).
failure_modes.fix: Provide a transform with the needed warp or set affine_only.
